Photo 0 is brighter and all 20 covers are legible; Photo 1 is a darker/dimmer shot of the identical arrangement.

Visible titles include: How to Win Friends and Influence People, Small Business Big Money, The Compound Effect (Darren Hardy), Zero to One, The Millionaire Next Door, This Is Marketing (Seth Godin), How Successful People Think (John C. Maxwell), Women Rise Up, What Every Woman Wants in a Man (Diana Hagee), Sell Like Crazy, The Seven Principles for Making Marriage Work (John Gottman), Bringing Out the Best in Your Marriage, Words That Matter, The Midas Touch, Spiritual Authority, How Europe Underdeveloped Africa (Walter Rodney), The Psychology of Money (Morgan Housel), and others partly visible.
